frozen_contract.protocol: Same starting state; A = intervention present, B = intervention absent.
frozen_contract.constraint: Do not run on every live task.
frozen_contract.acceptance_promotion_gates: Plan line 4169 (self-hosting dogfood acceptance checklist): 'that candidate passed counterfactual evaluation before promotion' is a factual/temporal claim, not a code-level promotion gate; §44 does not require promotion.promote() to call this machinery, and none was added.

named_implementation_surfaces: src/second_brain/credit.py:counterfactual_result (new; OBSERVED §44 effect across all six dimensions)
src/second_brain/credit.py:arm_from_telemetry (new; builds one arm from real current telemetry)
src/second_brain/telemetry.py:session_usage / session_tool_calls / session_wall_time_ms (new; real per-session token/tool/time aggregation from existing telemetry)

implementation_summary.extends_not_replaces: counterfactual_eval/eval_skill_credit are unchanged and remain the PREDICTED routing-selection probe. counterfactual_result is additive: it accepts a single shared starting_state (structurally enforcing the same-starting-state invariant — the two arms cannot diverge on it, since there is only one parameter), and two arms (with_arm/without_arm) each carrying run_id, success, tokens, tool_calls, wall_time_ms, verification, and regressions. A counterfactual_eval() result may be embedded as predicted_effect, kept structurally distinct from observed_effect.
implementation_summary.real_evidence_only: tokens/tool_calls/wall_time_ms come from telemetry.session_usage/session_tool_calls/session_wall_time_ms (real brainstem/telemetry/SCHEMA.md assistant_usage/tool_call/ts fields) via arm_from_telemetry(); success/verification/regressions are caller-supplied from existing requirement, P3.7/P3.8 verification, and test evidence, never derived from telemetry or model self-report. verification.outcome is validated against the exact passed/failed/unresolved vocabulary verify.py's evaluate_accuracy_gate already uses.
implementation_summary.no_fabrication: reasoning tokens stay None when the current telemetry schema never reports reasoning_tokens for a session (never invented as 0). arm_from_telemetry raises BrainError when telemetry.session_wall_time_ms returns None (fewer than two timestamped records for that session) instead of defaulting wall_time_ms to 0.0 — an absent/unmeasurable session is rejected, not silently reported as a zero-valued arm (closed after the first independent validator pass flagged it; tests/test_credit.py::test_arm_from_telemetry_rejects_absent_session and ::test_arm_from_telemetry_rejects_single_record_session).
implementation_summary.treatment_identity: counterfactual_result requires distinct with_arm/without_arm run_id (rejects a same-run reuse attempt) and binds an explicit intervention_hash; is_counterfactual_result_current(result, current_hash) detects when the intervention materially changed, so stale evidence cannot silently describe a new version.
implementation_summary.harness_neutral: One function (counterfactual_result) validates intervention_type against the exact five §44 classes (skill, memory, routing_policy, scout, verification_policy) — no per-class special-casing, no five separate evaluators; tested for all five in test_counterfactual_result_harness_neutral_across_intervention_types.
implementation_summary.bounded_persistence: Results are written as JSON to outputs/audits/counterfactual/<type>/<id>-<evaluation_id>.json; arms carry only counts/hashes/short evidence_refs, never raw transcripts or tool output (tested by test_counterfactual_result_persists_bounded_json_no_raw_content).
implementation_summary.optional_invocation: Nothing calls counterfactual_result automatically; ordinary credit/routing/outcome flows create zero files under outputs/audits/counterfactual/ (test_ordinary_flow_creates_no_counterfactual_evidence).
implementation_summary.evaluator_economics: counterfactual_result makes no model/tool calls of its own (pure local bookkeeping over evidence the caller already collected); its own overhead is reported honestly as evaluation_model_calls=0, evaluation_tokens=0, evaluation_tool_calls=0, plus a measured bookkeeping_wall_time_ms.
implementation_summary.regenerated_tests: tests/test_credit.py grew from 9 to 25 tests: full comparison + deltas, honest negative-effect reporting, same-run-id rejection, invalid intervention_type/verification-outcome/negative-token rejection, incomplete starting_state rejection, zero-regressions-measured-not-placeholder, treatment-identity staleness, bounded persistence, harness-neutral across all five intervention types, predicted-vs-observed distinctness, ordinary-flow non-invocation, real telemetry-derived arm construction, and absent/unmeasurable session rejection.
implementation_summary.full_suite: Full pytest suite (all files) passes with zero failures; ruff check/format and pyright clean on src and tests; Prime extension Vitest suite unaffected (Python-only change; one Windows temp-dir rmdir flake in active-state-wiring.test.ts confirmed pre-existing/unrelated — passes in isolation).

dogfood_evidence.task_identity: Identical task text on both arms, corroborated by the real omp_routing_invocation telemetry task_hash=a52f42b9b3e485c1 matching exactly on both sessions.
dogfood_evidence.measured_dimensions: All six §44 dimensions populated from real evidence: success=true/true (both_succeeded, objectively verified by grepping each session's raw transcript for the exact git-verified branch string, not model self-report); tokens.total 46662 vs 46350 (delta +312, real assistant_usage sums); tool_calls 1 vs 1 (delta 0, real tool_call counts); wall_time_ms 11718 vs 10622 (delta +1096, real ts-span); verification passed/passed (same, reused evidence vocabulary); regressions 0/0 (delta 0, real full-suite pass immediately before, neither arm touched code).

No positive bias was applied; the result is reported exactly as measured, consistent with the frozen instruction that a counterfactual result may legitimately be positive, neutral, negative, or inconclusive.
dogfood_evidence.treatment_identity_check: credit.is_counterfactual_result_current(result, result['intervention']['hash']) is True; the same check against a different hash is False — verified against this real (not synthetic) result.

requirement_classification.evidence: credit.py:counterfactual_eval unchanged (deterministic with/without router comparison); credit.py:counterfactual_result new (full six-dimension observed comparison). Both tested.

counterfactual_result validates and compares success, tokens (input/cache_read/cache_write/output/total/reasoning), tool_calls, wall_time_ms, verification, and regressions for every result; tested in test_counterfactual_result_full_comparison_and_deltas and dogfooded live.
starting_state is a single shared function argument (not per-arm), structurally preventing divergence; task_hash corroborated identical via real omp_routing_invocation telemetry in the live dogfood.

arm_from_telemetry sources tokens/tool_calls/wall_time from real brainstem telemetry (session_usage/session_tool_calls/session_wall_time_ms); success/verification/regressions are caller-supplied from existing verification/test evidence, never self-reported; reasoning tokens stay None when unavailable (never fabricated).

test_counterfactual_result_zero_regressions_measured_not_placeholder proves a real measured 0 is accepted and reported; arm_from_telemetry now raises BrainError (not a fabricated 0) when a session has fewer than two timestamped telemetry records — closed after the first independent validator pass identified the original zero-fallback as a fabrication risk.

is_counterfactual_result_current() rejects a changed intervention_hash; distinct with_arm/without_arm run_id is required (same-run reuse raises BrainError); verified on both synthetic tests and the real live dogfood result.
predicted_effect (optional, a counterfactual_eval() result) is stored separately from observed_effect; test_counterfactual_result_predicted_vs_observed_distinct confirms no field bleed-through.

One counterfactual_result() function validates and accepts all five §44 intervention classes (skill, memory, routing_policy, scout, verification_policy) — no per-class evaluator; tested explicitly for all five.

test_ordinary_flow_creates_no_counterfactual_evidence proves plain credit/routing/outcome flows never trigger this machinery; the two live dogfood sessions themselves ran a trivial task with zero forced A/B campaign.
evaluator_economics honestly reports zero model/tool calls of its own plus a real measured bookkeeping_wall_time_ms; verified in both unit tests and the live dogfood result (0.041ms).

Fresh current-session OMP-primary A/B pair (2026-08-26T11-07/11-08Z sessions), real telemetry, real lean_kernel decision divergence confirmed before building the result; superseding the prior qualification's stale 2026-08-14 evidence.

credit.py/telemetry.py/router.py/cli.py form a harness-neutral Python/CLI authority; no duplicate OMP-native counterfactual-eval subsystem exists or is needed for the frozen Universal local target.

reuse_decision: Reused credit.py's existing counterfactual_eval/eval_skill_credit machinery (kept as the PREDICTED effect layer), the existing brainstem telemetry schema (assistant_usage/tool_call/ts) via new read-only aggregation helpers in telemetry.py, verify.py's existing passed/failed/unresolved verification vocabulary, and the existing outputs/audits/ report-writer pattern. Did not build a second promotion framework, a duplicate OMP-native counterfactual subsystem, or five separate per-class evaluators. Did not conflate this work with the separate Lean Code e01-e16 HOLD_SHADOW campaign. Did not add promotion.py coupling. Lean remains HOLD_SHADOW.
